author: Ari Koslow
title: Cole Ragans (elbow) to undergo surgery Wednesday
desc: Cole Ragans will undergo elbow surgery on Wednesday.
impact: Per Rogers, the extent of the surgery will be determined once they get inside and see exactly what's going on. There will be an update provided on how long Ragans is expected to miss.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Erasmo Ramirez released by Rockies
desc: The Rockies released RHP Erasmo Ramírez.
impact: Ramirez did not make it to the majors after signing a minor league contract with Colorado.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Tyler Beede released by Cubs
desc: The Cubs released RHP Tyler Beede.
impact: Beede did not reach the majors after signing a minor league contract with the Cubs. He'll figure to seek another opportunity.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jorge Polanco (Achilles) to begin rehab assignment Saturday
desc: Jorge Polanco will begin a rehab assignment on Saturday with Triple-A Syracuse.
impact: Polanco will be back in game action for the first time since April 14. He is likely to require a lengthy rehab assignment.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Cade Povich activated from IL, optioned to Triple-A
desc: The Orioles activated Cade Povich from the 15-day injured list and optioned him to Triple-A Norfolk.
impact: Povich concluded his rehab assignment earlier this week. He will remain in Triple-A.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Kyle Nicolas designated for assignment
desc: The Orioles designated Kyle Nicolas for assignment.
impact: Nicolas loses his spot on the Orioles 40-man roster. He will head to waivers.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Dom Keegan claimed off waivers by Orioles
desc: The Orioles claimed Dom Keegan off waivers from the Rays.
impact: Keegan was designated for assignment by Tampa Bay. He'll add catching depth for Baltimore.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kevin McGonigle swipes two bases in win over Astros
desc: Kevin McGonigle went 1-for-2 in a win over the Astros with two walks, two runs scored, and two stolen bases.
impact: McGonigle continues a scorching stretch at the plate, collecting hits in 11 of his last 12 contests. The infielder remains one of the few impactful options as part of an underperforming Tigers lineup for manager AJ Hinch, carrying an .817 OPS with six home runs, 28 RBI, 49 runs scored, and 11 stolen bases across 79 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Blake Dunn (elbow) to likely be re-evaluated in Cincinnati
desc: Reds manager Terry Francona said Blake Dunn will "probably go back to Cincinnati for further evaluation."
impact: Dunn had X-rays return negative. There won't be any roster moves made as of now.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Kerry Carpenter goes yard in win over Astros
desc: Kerry Carpenter went 1-for-4 in a win over the Astros with a two-run home run.
impact: Carpenter has offered mixed results at the plate of late, recording hits on four of his last nine contests. The outfielder remains one of the more streaky options while flashing his explosive power stroke in the Tigers lineup for manager AJ Hinch, batting .220 with 11 home runs, 31 RBI, and 19 runs scored across 59 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Colt Keith belts solo homer in win over Astros
desc: Colt Keith went 1-for-3 in Friday's win over the Astros with a solo home run and one walk.
impact: Keith has provided mixed results at the plate of late, recording hits in four of his last nine contests. The infielder remains another inconsistent bat in the Tigers lineup for manager AJ Hinch, slashing .252 with five homers, 18 RBI, 29 runs scored and four steals through 74 games.

author: Chris Schommer
title: James Outman homers in shutout win
desc: James Outman went 1-for-2 in a win over the Astros with a home run, two runs scored, three RBI, and one walk.
impact: Outman continues a dismal stretch at the plate since arriving in Detroit, picking up hits in just three of his last 11 contests. The outfielder can remain off rosters in all formats, hitting .165 with two homers, eight RBI, 13 runs scored, and five steals through 60 games.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Yohendrick Pinango recalled from Triple-A
desc: The Blue Jays recalled Yohendrick Pinango from Triple-A Buffalo.
impact: Pinango had been placed on the taxi squad. He will be active for Saturday's game against the Rangers with Jesus Sanchez (ankle) placed on the injured list.

author: Chris Schommer
title: Keider Montero cruises over seven in win over Astros
desc: Keider Montero allowed five hits and one walk while striking out three over seven scoreless innings in Friday's win over the Astros.
impact: Montero continues a solid stretch on the mound, allowing two earned runs or less in four of his last six trips to the mound. The right-hander has offered manager another stable starting option in the Tigers rotation for manager AJ Hinch of late, posting a 3.39 ERA and 0.99 WHIP with a 4-5 record and 5.8 K/9 ratio across 16 starts.

author: Ari Koslow
title: Jesus Sanchez (ankle) placed on IL
desc: The Blue Jays placed Jesus Sanchez on the 10-day injured list with a right ankle sprain.
impact: Sanchez will miss some time after he had X-rays return negative. He does not hold a clear timetable to return.
